redirects.//: Nothing lives at the root: the game is served from the path it has always had.

rewrites.//: The export is statically rendered — one prerendered .html per route, not a single-page app — so each route resolves to its own file. Without these, a refresh on /settings 404s.
Catch-all last, so a mistyped deep link boots the router and lands on the game's own branded not-found screen rather than a bare 404.
